segments.name: Semiconductor process equipment
segments.description: Develops, manufactures, sells and supports semiconductor and thin film process equipment used by customers to make electronic devices.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and measures its results in one operating segment and therefore has one reportable segment: the development, manufacture, sales, and support of semiconductor and thin film process equipment primarily sold to make electronic devices.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including semiconductor manufacturers, IDMs, foundries, OSATs, governments, universities and research institutions, purchase the company's process equipment systems to produce current-generation devices in volume and develop next-generation products.
revenueModel.evidence: In general, our customers purchase our systems to both produce current-generation devices in volume and to develop next-generation products which deliver more efficient, cost-effective, and advanced technological solutions.
